question: What Is Voting Logic in a Safety Instrumented System?
body_html:
Voting logic in a safety instrumented system is the MooN rule that sets how many of N redundant channels must agree before the safety function trips. It trades safety, availability and cost.

ArchitectureTrips whenFavours
1oo1The single channel tripsNo redundancy
1oo2Either of two channels tripsSafety
2oo2Both channels agreeUptime, fewer spurious trips
2oo3Any two of three agreeBalance of safety and availability
